mapper.select: SELECT settings.id, settings.account_registration_enabled, settings.password_login_enabled, settings.password_registration_enabled, settings.google_login_enabled, settings.github_login_enabled, settings.updated_by, COALESCE(updater.display_name, updater.email) AS updated_by_display_name, settings.updated_at FROM auth_login_settings settings LEFT JOIN auth_users updater ON updater.id = settings.updated_by WHERE settings.id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_login_settings ( id, account_registration_enabled, password_login_enabled, password_registration_enabled, google_login_enabled, github_login_enabled, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{accountRegistrationEnabled}, #{passwordLoginEnabled}, #{passwordRegistrationEnabled}, #{googleLoginEnabled}, #{githubLoginEnabled}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_login_settings SET account_registration_enabled = #{accountRegistrationEnabled}, password_login_enabled = #{passwordLoginEnabled}, password_registration_enabled = #{passwordRegistrationEnabled}, google_login_enabled = #{googleLoginEnabled}, github_login_enabled = #{githubLoginEnabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = 1
